scope: Seven base batches, seven completed 20M panels and fifty-five new followup singleton queries: two Batch 02, seven Batch 03, ten Batch 04, eleven Batch 05, sixteen Batch 06 and nine Batch 07. limits: Measured VM lifetimes priced at recorded rate, not billing. Mean scaling only; panel sizes, discovered alternatives and availability vary. Inclusive scenarios retain ancillary storage/transfer/operations and recovery assumptions. Cloud-stage timing excludes preflight, retrieval, review pauses and final synthesis.

Remaining cloud-stage work excludes preflight, retrieval, deeper alternatives, independent reviews and final synthesis; availability and scientific obligations can add time.
